# Privacy Impact Review

Inspect permissions, dependencies, network paths, storage, logs,
exports, backups, notifications and external integrations.

Output a structured report containing:

- change summary,
- data categories,
- processing purpose,
- storage location,
- external recipients,
- retention impact,
- user controls,
- documentation changes,
- unresolved legal questions.

Do not provide legal approval.
